name: Copper mug
note: Traditional for a Moscow Mule; the copper keeps the outside cold to the touch and beads with condensation quickly.
iceDisplacementNote: No measured figure exists for this shape. Copied from the Collins glass on this site, which shares its 400 ml capacity — estimate. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
